votes.motion: Close the public hearing on RDA Budget Amendment No.1 for Fiscal Year 2024-25
votes.description: Closes the public hearing on the resolution to amend the RDA's FY2024-25 budget, which included allocating additional funding to the State Street commercial revolving loans program for an expanded public commercial daycare facility.

votes.motion: Approve the meeting minutes of August 13, 2024
votes.description: Approves the official meeting minutes of the RDA Board of Directors from August 13, 2024.

votes.motion: Adopt Resolution 19 of 2024, amending the Fiscal Year 2025 final budget of the Redevelopment Agency of Salt Lake City only for items as shown on the motion sheet
votes.description: Adopts a budget amendment to the RDA's FY2024-25 final budget, including additional funding to the State Street commercial revolving loans program for an expanded public commercial daycare facility as part of the Liberty Corner affordable multifamily development.

votes.motion: Adopt Resolution 20 of 2024, authorizing the disposition of the properties to the Utah Transit Authority for zero dollars with a right of reverter
votes.description: Authorizes a fully discounted conveyance of two Sugar House S-Line parcels at 2211 South 900 East and 1015 East Sugarmont Drive from the RDA to the Utah Transit Authority for no cost, with a right of reverter included.
